overall_design: 4 patients with NASH cirrhosis and 4 patients without NAFLD
summary: The progression from steatosis to nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) in nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) patients is one of the major causes of liver-related death worldwide and have limited effective therapies. We comparing the circular RNomics of liver fibroblasts isolated from patients with NAFLD-caused cirrhosis and the ones without NAFLD.
title: circRNA expression profiles of fibroblasts: normal vs. NASH cirrhosis
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
